scope: Static independent review plus three tiny synthetic checks; no raw-source scans or falsifier execution.
checks: Exact source FLIGHT_mvt airline parser; no callsign substitution.
Prior uses airport-month K10 and stand residual K50; unknown airlines excluded from stand contributions, missing stand stays NaN, unseen valid stand has zero support.
Departure targets enter only association; feature constructor depends only supplied arrival outcomes and departure month/stand.
Each fold uses original training months and immutable prepared Rome training IDs, airline and copy target.
Within-airline/month demeaning removes airline/month means for both target and feature; pure between-airline confounding returns zero slope.
Temporal halves and no-ID subgroup are fixed descriptive checks, not independent validation or evidence for causality.
observations: Upstream raw/identity expected hashes are retained rather than rescanned; later model feature promotion requires full guard verification.
Feature count excludes missing-airline arrivals, so document it as eligible stand-arrival support rather than all stand arrivals.
